card.line: The Valley of Slaughter is the new name God says will replace Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, a place of child burning, to show coming judgment on Judah.

moments.title: A new name for Topheth
moments.text: God says people built high places at Topheth to burn their sons and daughters, something He never commanded. He says the place will be called the Valley of Slaughter, and they will bury the dead there until there is no more room.

moments.title: Judgment named again
moments.text: God again says Topheth will be called the Valley of Slaughter. He says He will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem there, and they will fall by the sword before their enemies.

moments.title: The jar is shattered
moments.text: God tells Jeremiah to shatter a jar in front of the men with him. It shows that God will shatter the nation and city, and make Jerusalem like Topheth.
